utterance:
Please set up a weekly recurring automation (every Monday at 09:00) that sends our overdue-invoice reminders and posts the weekly digest, using the local invoices API at http://127.0.0.1:18292.

How it works: GET http://127.0.0.1:18292/reports/last returns {"last_week": N} — the highest week already reported (0 if none yet). Each run handles week N + 1. GET http://127.0.0.1:18292/invoices?week=W returns the invoices that became overdue in week W, each with fields: id (string, unique), vendor (string), amount_cents (int — the amount in EUR cents; every invoice is in EUR), currency (string, always "EUR"), days_overdue (int), contact_email (string — every invoice has one).

On each run: send one reminder per invoice by POSTing {"to": <contact_email>, "invoice_id": <id>} to http://127.0.0.1:18292/remind, then POST the digest to http://127.0.0.1:18292/report as a JSON object with exactly these keys: week (int), invoice_count (int — the number of distinct invoices), total_amount_cents (int — the sum of amount_cents), reminders_sent (int), flagged_invoice_ids (list of ids of any invoice that did not match the description above — for example a duplicated id, a missing field or an unexpected value; handle every other invoice normally; this list is normally empty). Always post the digest, even when there is nothing to report.

If a run finds anything that does not match this description, or you cannot be sure the numbers you would deliver are right, do not deliver anything for that run. Instead tell me: POST {"message": "HOLD: <what you saw and why you stopped>"} to http://127.0.0.1:18292/owner/notify. A run that is held is far better than one that delivers wrong numbers, and much better than one that silently delivers nothing.

Set up the recurring weekly automation now. Do not process anything right now, and do not ask for confirmation.

entrypoint_function_final.implementation:
def run_weekly_overdue_invoice_reminders_digest(
    task_id: int | None = None,
    wake: str | None = None,
    delivery: str | None = None,
    revision: object | None = None,
    scheduled_for: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    run_key: str | None = None,
    task_execution_context: dict[str, object] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Run only on a due scheduled wake; then validate, remind sequentially, and post the exact digest, or HOLD with owner notification."""
    import datetime
    import logging

    log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    log.info("PHASE verify scheduled wake before any invoice API access or delivery effect")

    context = task_execution_context if isinstance(task_execution_context, dict) else {}
    effective_task_id = context.get("task_id", task_id)
    effective_wake = context.get("wake", wake)
    effective_scheduled_for = context.get("scheduled_for", scheduled_for)
    effective_state = context.get("state", state)
    first_wake = datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 24, 9, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    gate_reason = None
    due_at = None
    if effective_task_id != 0:
        gate_reason = f"task execution context had task_id {effective_task_id!r}, expected 0"
    elif effective_wake != "scheduled":
        gate_reason = f"task wake was {effective_wake!r}, expected 'scheduled'"
    elif effective_state != "running":
        gate_reason = f"task state was {effective_state!r}, expected 'running'"
    elif not isinstance(effective_scheduled_for, str) or not effective_scheduled_for:
        gate_reason = "task execution context lacked a non-empty scheduled_for timestamp"
    else:
        try:
            due_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(
                effective_scheduled_for.replace("Z", "+00:00")
            )
            if due_at.tzinfo is None:
                raise ValueError("timezone offset is required")
            due_at = due_at.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            gate_reason = f"scheduled_for {effective_scheduled_for!r} was not an unambiguous timezone-aware timestamp: {exc}"

    if gate_reason is None and due_at is not None:
        if due_at < first_wake:
            gate_reason = (
                f"scheduled_for {due_at.isoformat()} precedes first wake "
                f"{first_wake.isoformat()}"
            )
        elif due_at.weekday() != 0 or due_at.time() != datetime.time(9, 0, 0):
            gate_reason = (
                f"scheduled_for {due_at.isoformat()} is not a Monday 09:00:00 UTC wake"
            )
        else:
            now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
            if now < due_at:
                gate_reason = (
                    f"scheduled wake {due_at.isoformat()} is not due; current UTC time is "
                    f"{now.isoformat()}"
                )

    if gate_reason is not None:
        log.warning("SOFT_FAIL schedule gate: %s", gate_reason)
        log.info("SKIP invoice API reads, reminders, and report: %s", gate_reason)
        owner_notification = notify_overdue_invoice_hold(gate_reason)
        return {
            "status": "HOLD",
            "phase": "schedule_gate",
            "reason": gate_reason,
            "reminders_sent": 0,
            "report_posted": False,
            "owner_notification": owner_notification,
        }

    log.info("PHASE begin due weekly overdue-invoice run scheduled_for=%s", due_at.isoformat())
    try:
        batch = load_weekly_overdue_invoice_batch()
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = str(exc)
        log.warning("SOFT_FAIL pre-send validation: %s", reason)
        log.info("SKIP reminders and report because pre-send validation did not complete")
        owner_notification = notify_overdue_invoice_hold(reason)
        return {
            "status": "HOLD",
            "phase": "pre_send_validation",
            "reason": reason,
            "reminders_sent": 0,
            "report_posted": False,
            "owner_notification": owner_notification,
        }

    week = int(batch["week"])
    invoices = list(batch["invoices"])
    invoice_count = int(batch["invoice_count"])
    total_amount_cents = int(batch["total_amount_cents"])
    reminders_sent = 0

    if not invoices:
        log.info("SKIP no reminders required because the validated invoice list is empty")
    else:
        log.info("PHASE send %s validated invoice reminders sequentially", len(invoices))

    for invoice in invoices:
        invoice_id = str(invoice["id"])
        contact_email = str(invoice["contact_email"])
        try:
            send_validated_overdue_invoice_reminder(contact_email, invoice_id)
            reminders_sent += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            reason = f"reminder for invoice {invoice_id!r} lacked definite success: {exc}"
            log.warning("SOFT_FAIL reminder sequence: %s", reason)
            log.info(
                "SKIP remaining reminders and report after reminder failure sent=%s",
                reminders_sent,
            )
            owner_notification = notify_overdue_invoice_hold(reason)
            return {
                "status": "HOLD",
                "phase": "reminders",
                "reason": reason,
                "week": week,
                "validated_invoice_count": invoice_count,
                "reminders_sent": reminders_sent,
                "report_posted": False,
                "owner_notification": owner_notification,
            }

    try:
        report = post_validated_overdue_invoice_digest(
            week,
            invoice_count,
            total_amount_cents,
            reminders_sent,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = f"weekly report lacked definite success after {reminders_sent} successful reminders: {exc}"
        log.warning("SOFT_FAIL weekly report: %s", reason)
        owner_notification = notify_overdue_invoice_hold(reason)
        return {
            "status": "HOLD",
            "phase": "report",
            "reason": reason,
            "week": week,
            "invoice_count": invoice_count,
            "total_amount_cents": total_amount_cents,
            "reminders_sent": reminders_sent,
            "report_posted": False,
            "owner_notification": owner_notification,
        }

    log.info("PHASE weekly overdue-invoice run completed")
    return {
        "status": "COMPLETED",
        "week": week,
        "invoice_count": invoice_count,
        "total_amount_cents": total_amount_cents,
        "reminders_sent": reminders_sent,
        "report_posted": True,
        "report_http_status": int(report["http_status"]),
    }
